steps.description: Establish target SDK 34 and apply the 3D application branding parameters.

steps.title: Configure 3D Skeuomorphic Color Palette

steps.description: Design a custom recessed LCD display bezel drawable to provide simulated depth and a physical LCD feel.

steps.description: Set up highly touch-responsive green equal key with layered shadow extrusions.

steps.description: Implement interactive tilt adjustments, Gyro modes, beveled displays, and a tiltable keyboard layout wrapper.

steps.description: Ensure multi-layered parsing processes run correctly on evaluate requests.
